configuration: Existing project renamed; allowed origin updated and new deployment verified. Provider key and judge code were not changed.

private_report_review.method: Local replay of the supplied action history against the exact core bytes identified in the report; all reported ledger fields reproduced.
private_report_review.confirmation_rejection: The confirmation number exceeded the existing number floor, but the recognized command word was below the existing command floor. This was not a lost-correction or premature-readback rejection.
private_report_review.privacy_finding: An access code had been entered as a typed stock transcript and therefore appeared in the original report history. The original report is kept private and unchanged.

shipped_changes: Spoken replies default on beside microphone setup, with a clear on/off status and the setting locked during active capture.
Recognizable access-code input is directed to the password field without entering the count ledger.
Exported voice-report copies redact recognizable and currently configured codes and disclose redactions; arbitrary sensitive speech still requires user review.
A session export containing recognized credential text is blocked instead of silently rewriting its replayable history.
Current repository instructions and example environment use the name-free URL. Historical receipts retain their original source locations.

verification.local_private_report_redaction_check: One known credential value removed from an export copy; original report and counts remained unchanged.

claim_boundary: The supplied interaction produced a correct unconfirmed draft, not a saved stock record or a successful spoken-readback interaction. New checks use authored software inputs, not another human validation.
